​Key Features of Muscle Monster - Workout Planner:

​Custom Workout Creation: Easily design your own personalized workout plans and exercise routines, tailored to your goals (e.g., muscle gain, strength, weight loss).

​Pre-Built Programs: Access a library of expertly designed workout programs for various fitness levels and goals, including bodybuilding, powerlifting, and home workouts.

​Detailed Exercise Library: Features a comprehensive list of exercises with step-by-step instructions, HD videos, and muscle-target illustrations to ensure proper form.

​Built-in Workout Tracker: Log your sets, reps, and weight lifted for every exercise. The app automatically tracks your progress and personal records (PRs).

​Progress Analysis: Monitor your strength gains, volume, and body measurements over time with detailed charts and statistics, keeping you motivated.

​Rest Timer: Includes an integrated, adjustable rest timer to help you maintain optimal recovery periods between sets.

​Intuitive Interface: Offers a simple, clean, and highly efficient interface designed to keep you focused on your workout and minimize distractions.
